Definition: a nestling (as being comparatively nude of feathers)
BiblicalUsage: gôwzâl is a plain word for a young bird, a nestling. In Genesis 15:9, the text says "and a young pigeon."
TheologicalSignificance: I take gôwzâl as it stands: a young bird, a nestling.
